board.title: Board
board.description: Move on-chain bitcoin into your Ark wallet.

refresh_all.title: Refresh all
refresh_all.description: Refresh all of your VTXOs in the next round.
refresh_all.started: Refresh started. Your VTXOs will renew in the next round.
refresh_all.error: Could not start refresh. Please try again.

board.title: Board
board.description: Move on-chain bitcoin into your Ark wallet. Funds become spendable off-chain once the funding transaction confirms.
board.onchain_fee_note: An on-chain transaction fee also applies.

errors.below_min: Amount is below the minimum board amount of {{amount}}.
errors.below_dust: Amount is too small to board after fees.

no_onchain.description: You have no on-chain bitcoin to board. Receive bitcoin to your on-chain wallet first.

toast.started: Board started. Funds will arrive once the transaction confirms.
toast.error: Could not start boarding. Please try again.

name.title: Wallet name
name.description: Enter a name for this wallet

show.title: Seed phrase
show.description: Take note of your seed phrase. Don't share it with anyone!

confirm.title: Confirm seed phrase
confirm.description: Click the words in the correct order

import.title: Import seed phrase
import.description: Type in all {{count}} words of your seed phrase

error.invalid: Invalid seed phrase. Check that all words are correct and in order.

backend.title: Network and servers
backend.description: Select a network and server to connect to

error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

birthday_height.label: Birthday height (optional)
birthday_height.description: The block height your wallet was first used at. This chain source scans from its own index, so the value is not used — leave it blank unless you know it.
birthday_height.description_required: The block height your wallet was first used at. Blocks before it are skipped during the initial scan. A bitcoind chain source requires it when importing a seed; if you are unsure, use the height your wallet was created at or an earlier one.
birthday_height.error: Enter a whole block height greater than 0, or leave the field blank.
birthday_height.error_required: Enter a whole block height greater than 0.

require.amount: To generate a Lightning invoice, enter an amount

payto.error: Unable to generate unified pay-to address. Try again.
payto.needs_amount: Enter an amount to receive over Lightning.

lightning.needs_amount: Enter an amount to generate a Lightning invoice.

onchain.description: Receives on-chain bitcoin. You can board it onto Ark later.

tags.label: Tags
tags.hint: Select a tag or create one

scan.description: Scan any bitcoin, Lightning, or Ark QR code to pay.

confirm.description: Review the payment details before sending.

contacts.label: Contacts
contacts.hint: Select a contact or create one

movements.title: History
movements.empty_description: Send or receive sats and they will show up here.

detail.title: VTXO details
detail.policy_tooltip: How this VTXO can be spent. "Pubkey" is the standard type.
detail.exit_delta_tooltip: Blocks to wait after the final exit transaction confirms before you can claim.
detail.exit_depth_tooltip: How many on-chain transactions required to fully exit this VTXO.

offboard.fee_note: On-chain transaction fee is deducted from the offboarded amount.

emergency_exit.description: Emergency exits can take time. Your wallet will broadcast multiple on-chain transactions in consecutive order, and each transaction has its own timelock delay.

fiat_currency.label: Fiat currency
fiat_currency.description: Transaction history rates are based on the latest bitcoin price, not the price at transaction time.

threshold.label: Auto-refresh threshold
threshold.description: Automatically refreshes any VTXO whose lifetime drops below this threshold.

on_receive.label: Refresh on receive
on_receive.description: Enable to refresh received VTXOs in the next available round, rather than waiting until they approach expiry. Max security, max fees.

seed_phrase.label: Seed phrase
seed_phrase.description: Write this down to back up your wallet's keys

backup_warning.title: Your seed phrase is not a complete backup
backup_warning.description: To recover your wallet, you'll need both your seed phrase and a continuous backup of the wallet data directory at {{path}}.

community_forum.label: Community forum
community_forum.description: Ask questions and get advice from the community

community_chat.label: Community chat
community_chat.description: Technical support for developers building on Bark

report_issues.label: Report an issue
report_issues.description: Report a bug or request a feature

diagnostics.label: Diagnostic logs
diagnostics.description: Download the barkd debug log to share with support when troubleshooting.
diagnostics.error: Could not download logs. Please try again.

emergency_exit.label: Emergency exit all
emergency_exit.description: Use only when the Ark server is unresponsive. Making an on-chain payment is a faster, cheaper way to move your bitcoin on-chain.

confirm.title: Emergency exit all?
confirm.description: Emergency exits can take time. Your wallet will broadcast multiple on-chain transactions in consecutive order, and each transaction has its own timelock delay.

edit.title: Change destination address
edit.description: Update the address that will receive the swept bitcoin once exit outputs are claimable.

emergency_exit.address_help: Double-check the address before proceeding. An emergency exit cannot be canceled once started.

estimate.title: Estimated total cost
estimate.hint: Roughly the most you'll pay. The final cost depends on the on-chain fee rate when each transaction is broadcast.
estimate.insufficient: You don't have enough on-chain bitcoin to cover the exit fees. Deposit more to continue.

delete_wallet.label: Delete wallet
delete_wallet.description: Delete this wallet and create a new one. This cannot be undone.

confirm.title: Delete this wallet?
confirm.description: Your current wallet will be deleted and a fresh wallet will be created. Make sure you have backed up your wallet first.

chart.title: Balance over time
chart.empty_description: Your balance over time will appear once you start using the wallet.

errors.price_fetch_failed: Failed to fetch bitcoin price from {{provider}}
